data.name: About_Brand_Tagline
data.value: Your PC's folder, within reach of any device.

data.name: About_Brand_Description
data.value: CPFS shares one folder on a Windows 10 or 11 PC with Windows, macOS, Linux, Android and iOS devices. They connect by the PC's name (ComputerName.local), by its Wi-Fi or LAN address, or by a VPN address, and a phone can connect with a QR code. Sharing is limited to that folder, with a separate account and hardened Windows settings, and the uninstall puts the original settings back. If you run a Linux server, CPFS can also sync one subfolder with it over an encrypted channel. A file deleted or replaced on one side is kept in a versions folder on the other.
